# Times Internet Languages Live

> Times Internet Languages Live is the vernacular-first events arm of Times Internet - a curated portfolio of region-first events across healthcare, education, entertainment & lifestyle, and MSMEs, built for the audiences, cities, and languages that move modern India.

- Audiences: brands and policymakers who sponsor or partner on regional event IPs; everyday Indians who attend, learn and register for summits.
- Cities: Delhi, Mumbai, Pune, Jaipur, Bhopal, Patna, Lucknow, Chennai, Ahmedabad, Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Surat.
- Languages: Hindi, English, Hinglish and regional languages.
- Partnerships: write to deepika.pawar@timesinternet.in or use https://timeslanguages.in/#partners

## Upcoming Events

- [Times Future of Maternity: South Edition 2026](https://timeslanguages.in/tfm-blr): Meet the doctors, hospitals, specialists, innovators, and trusted brands helping families across South India make informed choices. (October 2026, Bengaluru; language: en)
- [Nivesh Baithak: Surat Edition](https://timeslanguages.in/nivesh-baithak/surat): A Hindi-first investor education summit for everyday investors, learners, and wealth creators. (October 2026, Surat; language: hi)
- [India MSME Dialogue: Atmanirbhar Udyam | Atmanirbhar Bharat](https://timeslanguages.in/msme): A multi-state, multi-language platform uniting regional MSMEs. (September 2026, Uttar Pradesh; language: hi)

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is Times Internet Languages Live?

Times Internet Languages Live is the vernacular-first events arm of Times Internet - a curated portfolio of region-first experiences across healthcare, education, entertainment & lifestyle, and MSMEs, built for the audiences, cities, and languages that move modern India.

### Which domains do Times Internet Languages Live events cover?

Our events span healthcare, education, entertainment & lifestyle, and MSMEs - each designed for a regional audience, grounded in regional context, and focused on real decisions like business growth, careers, and community health.

### What are the flagship events?

Our flagship IPs include Times Future of Maternity, Times Study Abroad Conclave, Nivesh Baithak, Astro Mahasangam, VK Real Estate Awards & Summit, and India MSME Dialogue.

### How can brands partner with Times Internet Languages Live?

We offer tailored formats - from speaking slots and title sponsorships to integrated regional campaigns. Write to deepika.pawar@timesinternet.in for the partnership deck.

### How do I attend or register?

Every event has its own microsite linked from the calendar above. Tap the primary action on any card to register, view the agenda, or claim a counselling slot.
